newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 76,400 MT recovered from the slow pace of recent weeks. Major increases for Mexico (36,300 MT), Canada (15,100 MT), and Israel (15,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for Japan (15,100 MT).
Sales of 590,200 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for unknown destinations (320,200 MT), the Netherlands (86,400 MT), and China (77,000 MT).
Exports of 99,100 MT were off 57 percent from the previous week and the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (46,200 MT) and Japan (35,100 MT).
